issue: New entry not persisted across page reload
actual: Created entry "Alpha QA Task" (Priority 7, Mar 5 2026, Completed checked, Notes "Zebra note"); it appeared immediately and count went 5 -> 6 entries. After reloading http://localhost:7074/, the count returned to "5 entries" and the new entry was gone (table rows back to the original 5 seed entries). The added "Notes" field was also lost.
evidence: Post-reload rows: Design new landing page / Review marketing materials / Update API documentation / Prepare quarterly report / Team sync meeting notes; statusbar.count = "5 entries"
Field config dialog type select offers labeled options Text/Number/Date/Checkbox; entry form renders input[type=text], input[type=number], input[type=date], and a role=checkbox button respectively

Added "Notes" (Text) and "Score" (Number) via Fields dialog; both appear as table columns, card fields ("—" when empty), sort options, and inputs in the Add Entry form. Type dropdown offers text/number/date/checkbox.

Saved entry "Alpha QA Task" with text=Alpha QA Task, number=7, date=2026-03-05, checkbox=checked, Notes="Zebra note"; card view shows 7 / Mar 5, 2026 / Yes / Zebra note and table view shows 7 / Mar 5, 2026 / check icon / Zebra note
Toggled Cards -> Table; count stayed "6 entries" and all field values identical in both views
Priority is input[type=number]; typing "abc" left value "7" (validity.valid=true, badInput=false) and the saved entry stored 7
Due Date is input[type=date]; assigning "2026-13-45" was rejected (value became ""), while valid 2026-03-05 saved and renders as "Mar 5, 2026"
All 6 entries and every field value match across table and card views; empty Notes/Score render as "—" in both views
Entry form uses a role=checkbox control that toggles checked; table shows green check vs muted X icon; cards show "Yes" vs "No" consistently per entry
Before/after sorting by Task Name asc then desc, count stayed "6 entries" and the multiset of row values was identical (e.g. "Alpha QA Task | 7 | Mar 5, 2026 | CHECK | Zebra note | 0")

Selecting "Task Name" in the Sort dropdown immediately reordered rows A→U; clicking the header toggled to descending with an arrow-down indicator on the active column and the Sort control label showing "Task Name"; app stayed interactive

Table: sorted Task Name asc then desc (header arrow indicator). Cards: sorted Priority asc then desc (statusbar "Sorted by Priority (descending)"). Switching Table<->Cards preserved each view's own sort (table stayed Task Name desc, cards stayed Priority).

actual: The app exposes only Fields, Sort, Table/Cards toggle, Add Entry and a free-text Search box. There is no filter control anywhere: full DOM scan of the page and of the Configure Fields dialog found no element with "filter" text or a filter-related data-semtag-id, so field-specific filter criteria cannot be defined or cleared.

issue: Filtering not implemented, so filter inclusion/clearing cannot hold
actual: No filter UI exists (toolbar contains only Fields, Search, Sort, Table/Cards, Add Entry). With no way to activate filter criteria, the requirement that filtering include exactly matching entries and clearing restore all entries cannot be satisfied.

The Configure Fields dialog states "Configure fields before importing data", but no import control exists anywhere: the dialog contains only field name inputs, type selects, delete buttons, Add and Close; the toolbar has no import/upload button and the page contains no file input. Import of data (and therefore type-mismatch rejection) cannot be exercised.

evidence: Search "MARKETING" matched "Review marketing materials" case-insensitively with count '1 entry matching "MARKETING"'; "zebra" matched the Notes value; clearing the box restored all 6 entries and count "6 entries"

issue: Quick search matches raw stored values, not the displayed formatted values
actual: Entry "Alpha QA Task" displays Due Date "Mar 5, 2026" and Completed "Yes". Searching the displayed text returns nothing: "Mar 5" -> '0 entries matching "Mar 5"', "Yes" -> '0 entries matching "Yes"'. Searching raw values does match: "2026-03-05" -> 1 entry, "true" -> 3 entries.

evidence: With sort cleared ("Clear sort"), table drag handle reorder moved "Design new landing page" from position 1 to 3; in cards, "Team sync meeting notes" was moved to position 1. Switching views preserved each view's own manual order (table: Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team, Alpha; cards: Team, Design, Review, Update, Prepare, Alpha). Note: dnd-kit reorder was actuated via its keyboard sortable path; Playwright's synthetic mouse dragTo produced no reorder.
